title: Next: newshell on ed209g, driven by Codex
summary: Goal (Tom Dyer, 2026-11-24): put newshell on ed209g (cats1) and have Codex drive the work there through it. Needed first: Codex as a principal (codex) that submits proposals and plans directly and receives the same reports (mailbox, not the in-process inbox); objects to start an MU, examine networks (interfaces, routes, the nft fence read-only), xtpd status, services; orphan-process cleanup for a died step; an autopilot budget per chain; kit for cats1 built in the jammy chroot. Every machine change goes as an order marked NEEDS TOM'S DIRECT APPROVAL.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Never without Tom's explicit yes: change a firewall, rotate or copy a key, replace the WAN forwarder, reboot a host
